name: apisrouter
description: Buy social, search and web data for an agent task from the APIsRouter catalog, with a quote before every purchase.

interface.longDescription: APIsRouter gives an agent paid access to a catalog of social, search and web data operations: profiles, posts, comments, search results, keyword and site metrics, and more. The agent searches the catalog, reads the exact contract and price, gets a quote, and buys only within the limit the account holder approved. Results and charges show up in the APIsRouter console.
defaultPrompt: Find the APIsRouter operation that returns a TikTok creator's recent posts and quote one call.
Use APIsRouter to pull the Google search results for "best crm for startups" and summarize the top ten.
Help me read the result of an existing APIsRouter request; ask me for its request reference first.
